Oneliner

Detect the risk and severity of wildfires in selected locations.
Description

Carry a small camera to photograph Earth from space and determine the stability of the satellite. Main payload is a de-orbiting solution.

In February 2024, Astraeus-01's ambitions rose to that of fighting wildfires from space when it finally received a formal mission: to detect the risk and severity of wildfires in selected locations.
